summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Alfredo Ormando, a gay writer born 15 December 1958 in San Cataldo and died 23 January 1998 in Rome. He died after setting himself on fire outside Saint Peter's Basilica. The note states that the act was a protest against the Roman Catholic Church's ongoing condemnation of homosexuality.
one_line: Alfredo Ormando was a gay writer from Palermo who died in 1998 after self-immolation outside Saint Peter's Basilica in protest against Church condemnation of homosexuality.
key_facts: Alfredo Ormando was born on 15 December 1958 in San Cataldo.
Alfredo Ormando died on 23 January 1998 in Rome.
Alfredo Ormando was a gay writer from Palermo.
Alfredo Ormando died as a result of setting himself on fire outside Saint Peter's Basilica.
Alfredo Ormando's self-immolation was an act of protest against the Roman Catholic Church's ongoing condemnation of homosexuality.
